title: Fix pre-commit hook: it silently swallows lint/fmt failures (no exit propagation)
description: VERIFIED: .githooks/pre-commit runs `make fmt-check` and `make lint` but has NO exit-code propagation — no `set -e`, no `exit $?`, no `|| exit`. A failing lint or format check still falls through to '✅ Pre-commit checks complete' and the commit succeeds. This is a silent no-op gate (the exact anti-pattern from holistic-improvement-audit 'pre-commit hook gates that silently pass'). Compounding it: Makefile fmt-check-frontend runs `npx prettier --check src/` but prettier is NOT in web/package.json (only resolvable via a stale npx cache dir) — on a clean machine this step fails, and the hook swallows that too. Fix: add `set -e` (or capture exit codes and exit non-zero), make the hook fail the commit when lint/fmt fail, and either add prettier as a devDependency with a .prettierrc or drop the prettier step from the hook until it's a real dependency.

title: Wire Playwright E2E tests (13 specs in web/e2e/) into CI — currently never run
description: VERIFIED: web/e2e/ contains 13 Playwright spec files (homepage, live-tv, movies, series, search, guide, watchlist, settings, navigation, mobile, history, recordings, error-states) and `npm run test:e2e` is defined, but NO GitHub Actions job executes them. .github/workflows/e2e.yml is misnamed — it is actually the 'Release Build' workflow (docker build+push to ghcr.io on master/release branches) and never invokes playwright. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs pytest, vitest, tsc, and build only. Result: 13 E2E specs are dead weight — they can rot or break without any signal. Fix: add an e2e job to ci.yml (or rename e2e.yml properly) that runs `npm run test:e2e` against a built frontend + backend, or document explicitly why E2E is excluded.

title: Add Prettier config (ESLint flat config already exists)
description: VERIFIED: web/eslint.config.js EXISTS (ESLint 10.6.0) — the old 'no ESLint' suggestion is stale. But there is NO Prettier config (.prettierrc) and no prettier dependency in package.json, yet Makefile fmt-check-frontend and the pre-commit hook invoke `npx prettier --check src/`. 177 TS/TSX files have no formatting standard, so style drift continues across PRs. Add prettier + .prettierrc (single quotes, semi, 120 width to match the codebase style), wire a format script, and run a one-time format pass. This also unbreaks the pre-commit fmt-check step.

title: Tighten CSP script-src (currently 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval') or document the tradeoff
description: VERIFIED: server/main.py SecurityHeadersMiddleware sets script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'. unsafe-eval is required by hls.js/shaka (WebAssembly/worker eval patterns) and unsafe-inline by React hydration, but this combination defeats most XSS mitigations. Audit whether hls.js/shaka truly need unsafe-eval at runtime (modern versions don't always); if they do, document the accepted risk in SECURITY_AUDIT.md with a rationale instead of leaving it silent.

title: Verify stream preflight latency and CDN behavior at runtime
description: VERIFIED CODE (session 2026-07-31): preflight_stream() in server/routes/stream_core.py opens a short aiohttp connection (status check + 1-byte read) before every live/VOD/remux/transcode/proxy StreamingResponse so dead channels return 502 instead of 200-with-empty-body; results are cached short-TTL (30s success / 5s failure) keyed by URL+Range, with env-configurable STREAM_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT. Unit + route tests added (test_stream.py, test_stream_live.py TestPreflightFailure, test_stream_vod.py TestPreflightFailure) and passing — full backend suite 1379 pass / 17 skip / 3 xfail. Remaining risk: verify against the real provider (iptv-provider.example.com) that (a) channel zapping latency is acceptable with the cache, (b) the 1-byte read does not desync mpegts.js, (c) dead channel IDs (e.g. 250, 1) now return 502 quickly.
